verdict.rationale: Supabase provides building blocks that could support event-driven automation—Realtime 'Postgres Changes' to listen to database events and Edge Functions for server-side actions—but the evidence pack never documents an explicit rules/triggers or webhooks mechanism for automatically firing actions on events. Missing for 10: explicit Database Webhooks or trigger-configuration documentation, a concrete example wiring an event to an automated action, and independent/hands-on confirmation of such automation working end-to-end.
